exact_arithmetic_and_counterexamples.detail: A=I_5 has five singular values 1 but every physical off-diagonal block A[I,J] is zero; thus the unqualified abstract random-sign sentence is false.

exact_arithmetic_and_counterexamples.name: C01 seam objection
exact_arithmetic_and_counterexamples.detail: theta=0 and theta=2pi represent the same ray endpoint behavior; [0,2pi) is not an open 1-manifold chart giving the claimed global diffeomorphism. Removing one ray repairs change of variables a.e.

exact_arithmetic_and_counterexamples.name: C03 critical level
exact_arithmetic_and_counterexamples.detail: For indefinite nondegenerate q, q=v is two affine lines after centering; the joint law is absolutely continuous, hence the critical level has probability zero.
